label: Maps and location quest
summary: Use map or location evidence for a game while making spoofing, privacy and service trust explicit.
requiredFacts: Location precision, chosen proof architecture, acceptance radius and time window
Whether evidence uses a physical marker, local or onchain attestation, zero knowledge, or a signed service
Which map or geolocation provider is trusted and its outage behavior
Personal-data collection, retention, deletion and user consent
requiredFiles: Location verification service or proof adapter
requiredTests: Spoofed, stale, duplicated and impossible-location evidence
Provider outage, quota and malformed response handling
Deletion, minimization and reward replay scenarios
risks: Location can reveal sensitive personal behavior
Commodity GPS evidence is easy to spoof
External map services can fail or change terms
